column1: # Evaluated top to bottom; the first matching rule wins. Packets that match
# no rule get the DEFAULT action. Only IPv4 packets are evaluated.
#   PROTOCOL  ANY | TCP | UDP | ICMP | <IP protocol number>
#   PORT      ANY | n | lo-hi   (a rule with ports never matches ICMP or later fragments)
#   REASON    free text shown on BLOCK lines (optional)
# Rules are stateless: replies need their own ALLOW (note the resolver's
# answers come FROM port 53 and would otherwise hit "Blocked DNS").
